contentText: Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in France meeting his Group of Seven foreign minister counterparts Friday after President Donald Trump attacked NATO countries over a reluctance or refusal to take part in the Iran war, a conflict that some of America’s closest allies have met with deep skepticism. Trump’s vitriolic comments about NATO during a Cabinet meeting Thursday will likely make it an even tougher task. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Philip Turle tells us more.
